description: Append-only negotiation history. This is what makes 'we agreed to X' auditable. Import EIGHTEENTH (depends on campaigns)
notes: NEVER updated and NEVER deleted. Every proposal writes a new row with version = previous + 1.
rules_hash is sha256 of the canonicalized (key-sorted) rules_json, so both clients compute the same value.
The campaign-rules-diff UI renders version N-1 against version N so nobody accepts changed terms blind.
